raw_response:
Answer: C
Reason: The clinical history and imaging findings (right lung hypoplasia, anomalous systemic arterial supply shown in the CT images) are characteristic of Scimitar syndrome. In this condition, the scimitar vein runs parallel to the right heart border draining into the IVC, and the associated right lung hypoplasia typically causes a shift of the mediastinum to the right.
